mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity cash flows, producing statistically significant positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS < 0.2% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of cases or the Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST) above 550 and retail sales (RSAFS) above 370000 indicate robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint condition HOUST>550 and RSAFS>370000 fails to predict positive returns when S&P 500 returns are negative in >60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Inflationary cycles (CPIAUCSL > 220) combined with rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS) compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 220, S&P 500 returns are positive in >50% of 60-day windows or the Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 95 (INDPRO) reflects strong manufacturing output that supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 95 periods show non-significant positive 20-day returns (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment below 130000 (PAYEMS) indicates labor market weakness that suppresses consumer income and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS < 130000 periods yield positive 5-day returns in >40% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 13000) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST > 550) signals sustained economic expansion that fuels corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The GDPC1>13000 and HOUST>550 joint signal fails when S&P 500 returns are negative in >60% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0) increase cost of capital and reduce equity attractiveness, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.0 periods produce positive 60-day returns in >50% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03.
